description: Manage Yellow.ai users, events, Inbox tickets and views across supported regions.

yellow_ai_ticket_added_trigger.description: Runs each time a ticket is created in Yellow.ai. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

yellow_ai_ticket_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a ticket changes in Yellow.ai. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
